0022600137.text: The New York Knicks (1-3, 12th in the East, 2 games back in the Atlantic) visit the Chicago Bulls (1-3, on a two-game losing streak, 11th in the East, 2 games back in the Central) in the Knicks' 5th game of the season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-96 win in New York on April 3, 2026. Jose Alvarado is out for the Knicks with an ankle sprain, while the Bulls are missing Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and Tobe Awaka is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision.
